title: 秋实庄园

selectedMaster.selection: 首轮目视：左中皇后、横向葡萄棚、右下卧鹿与果篮及远方麦田清楚，石座接前坡；仅执行者选定母版，未做用户审美复核。

generationRuns.prompt: Create ONE original opaque full-canvas 1024x1536 vertical Empress tarot master, theme 秋实庄园 / Autumn Harvest Estate. Use supplied card for queen identity only: one graceful dark-haired floral-crowned queen in ivory dress and deep wine-red cloak, holding one rose. Include exactly one reclining spotted fawn, one full fruit basket and visible ripe wheat. New autumn vineyard setting: queen sits at LEFT CENTER under a horizontal grape arbor, warm sunset pouring sideways through vines toward a mature golden wheatfield, fawn reclining at LOWER RIGHT beside basket. Palette wine red, wheat gold, olive green. A substantial stone seat base joins the front earth slope continuously, both fill lower bleed; fawn and basket visibly supported. Avoid copied moonlit lake composition. Fine hand-painted fantasy tarot art, narrow celestial gold border, nuanced natural skin and cloth. Keep all core objects distinct and legs of fawn readable. No extra person, extra deer, text, title, lettering, numbers, watermark or logo. One complete opaque illustration.
generationRuns.conclusion: Selected opaque master after first-pass visual check; no transparent layers or assembly.

generationRuns.prompt: Edit the supplied image. Output exactly one 1024x1536 image. Keep the original canvas coordinates and size of RETAINED objects only. Objects explicitly removed must be deleted completely; do not preserve their number. No redesign, no recentering, no frame except when frame is specifically requested. BACKGROUND PLATE ONLY. Delete ALL people, ALL animals, ALL main foreground props, ALL foreground support platforms/floors and their contact shadows, ALL floating foreground decoration, and the entire outer border/corner ornaments. NO people or animals may remain, including silhouettes and reflections. Reconstruct the distant environment naturally behind deleted objects. Keep only the distant landscape/architecture and original atmosphere. Do not add a second copy of the support ground. Opaque RGB image. Specific removed connected group: 人物、玫瑰、石座一组；卧鹿果篮保持地面接触；本主题支撑归属：石座底座与麦田前土坡完整. Environment ownership details: 除主体完整连接组、独立前景和固定框外的环境；必须补全清除区域，不保留重复主体或接触阴影。. Highest priority: an EMPTY clean environment, absolutely no protagonists or foreground props. Remove ALL decorative symbols attached to the margins, including the upper and lower crescents, attached stars, corner ornaments and rectangular border strokes. Fill those pixels with continuous natural environment textures. The result is a full-bleed clean background with absolutely NO card furniture. Image 1 is the edit target; opaque background plate.
generationRuns.conclusion: Generated candidate; user requested collective visual acceptance later.
